original_name: P4-EMAIL: exactly one notification message with dictated subject and recipient
description: P4-EMAIL: exactly one notification message with dictated subject and recipient

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_headers h JOIN message_parts p ON h.message_part_id=p.id WHERE p.message_id=m.id AND h.name='Subject' AND h.value='Ticket INC-000102 re-pointed and still open') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_headers h2 JOIN message_parts p2 ON h2.message_part_id=p2.id WHERE p2.message_id=m.id AND h2.name='To' AND h2.value LIKE '%priya.nadkarni@servicenow.com%');

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name IN ('To','Cc','Bcc') AND value LIKE '%priya.nadkarni@contractors.servicenow.com%';
